parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. If you use an AccessKey pair or STS for temporary authorization, you do not need to specify this parameter.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the group.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The ID of the organization. You can obtain the organization ID from the URL of the organization's homepage in the console. The URL is in the following format: https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: The keyword for searching for code groups by name.
